presetDescription.default: The platform uses ipwho.is and automatically switches to an HTTPS fallback on timeout, rate limit, or parse failure.

title: IP geolocation data source
description: The default source is ipwho.is (free, HTTPS and latitude/longitude). Switch to the Bilibili preset when needed. Timeouts, rate limits and parse failures use the HTTPS fallback and never block the page.

mapping.title: Response field mapping
mapping.description: Map fields returned by a custom endpoint to platform location data without writing a complete parser rule.
mapping.guideDescription: Configure at least one valid field. Latitude and longitude must both be set or both left empty. After a successful test, select a discovered response field or enter a path such as $.data.city manually.
mapping.testHint: Tests time out after 5 seconds, cap responses at 256 KiB, and block private, loopback, and cross-origin redirect targets.
mapping.pathPlaceholder: Choose a discovered field or enter a JSON path
mapping.testInvalid: The test succeeded, but some selected fields could not be parsed. Check the highlighted mappings.
mapping.testSuccess: The data source test succeeded and selectable response fields were discovered.
mapping.testChooseMapping: Response fields were discovered. Select at least one mapping before saving.
